newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK FINMIN SAYS TOYOTA MULLING PLANT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK FINMIN SAYS TOYOTA MULLING PLANT.

text.p: Japanese automaker Toyota is considering locating a car production plant in eastern Slovakia, Slovak Finance Minister Sergeij Kozlik said on Monday.

"When Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar visited Japan earlier this month he presented a study for a large automobile production plant in eastern Slovakia with which he visited Toyota," Kozlik told journalists.

Kozlik was commenting on remarks by Meciar that Slovakia was ready to support the construction of a large automobile plant in Slovakia. "Toyota said they were interested in expanding out...and indicated they were interested in central Europe," he added.
Meciar and Kozlik were both speaking at a ground-breaking ceremony for the start of construction of a new residue upgrading project at the Slovnaft a.s. oil refinery.
